newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA TELKOM NEWS DELAYED FEW HOURS -SOURCES.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA TELKOM NEWS DELAYED FEW HOURS -SOURCES.

text.p: An announcement detailing the partial privatisation of South African utility Telkom has been delayed by a few hours, industry sources said on Wednesday.

South Africa's Posts, Telecommunications and Broadcasting Ministry had called a news conference for 1200 GMT but sources said this had been delayed for technical reasons. There were no significant obstacles to the finalisation of the deal, they added.
Officials said this week that the government was finalising terms for the sale of 30 percent of the concern to SBC Communications Inc and Telekom Malaysia Bhd .
Analysts expect the sale to raise some six billion rand.
